name: english
description: 纸间微光个人阅读空间前端组件层

scripts.build:sites: npm run build:modern && npm run build:intl
scripts.deploy:jdcloud: python3 tools/deploy_remote.py --target 京东云服务器 --upgrade --timeout 14400
scripts.sync:jdcloud:public: python3 tools/deploy_remote.py --target 京东云服务器 --sync-public
scripts.test:extensive: node --test frontend/src/utils/extensiveReading.test.mjs frontend/src/utils/epubSource.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_reading_document.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_epub_document.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_source_reading.py
scripts.test:ui: python3 tools/test_mobile_reader_presentation.py && python3 tools/test_private_site_presentation.py && python3 tools/test_remote_reader_presentation.py && python3 tools/test_reader_performance.py
